# apollo/search

A built-in source adapter for person records: it needs nothing and provides 6 fields. Plan prices it at $0 per record, and it demands `APOLLO_API_KEY`.

## Manifest

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| id | `apollo/search` |
| version | 2 |
| role | source |
| entity type | person |
| credentials | `APOLLO_API_KEY` |
| cost estimate per record | $0 |

## Needs

Nothing. A source starts a run, so no record precedes it.

## Provides

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "apollo.has_email": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "apollo.id": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "company_name": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "first_name": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "last_name": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "type": "object"
}
```

## Config keys

The keys `with:` accepts. Plan rejects any other key.

| Key | Type | Required | What it sets |
|---|---|---|---|
| `base_url` | string |  | Override the API host (testing) |
| `domains` | array of string |  | q_organization_domains |
| `employee_ranges` | array of string |  | organization_num_employees_ranges, such as "50,200" |
| `limit` | integer |  | Stop after this many people |
| `locations` | array of string |  | organization_locations |
| `per_page` | integer |  |  |
| `query` | string |  | Free-text search, such as "vp marketing, saas, 50-200 employees" |
| `seniorities` | array of string |  | person_seniorities |
| `titles` | array of string |  | person_titles |

## Example

From [See it run](/start/show-me):

```yaml
source:
  use: apollo/search
  with:
    query: vp marketing, saas
    limit: 1
```
